name: Bleeding text
description: A title that starts to bleed: blood seeps down through its letters from the top, drips run from its baseline and swell, a few drops fall, then it all fades back to clean letters.

name: Blood moon
description: A crimson full moon hanging over dark hills and a lone dead tree, its cratered face glowing through drifting clouds, the sky round it stained red and pricked with faint stars.

name: Claw slash
description: Claw marks raked across a picture in a fast stroke, each tear ripping open along its length with ragged raw edges and the picture pulled apart round it, holding a moment, then closing up again. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Blood drip border
description: A glossy band of blood along the top of the frame, drips creeping down from it at their own pace, swelling at their tips and letting drops fall, then thinning away as new ones start; a transparent overlay.

name: Heartbeat vignette
description: A deep red edge round a picture pulsing like a heartbeat, quickening and closing in as the pointer gets nearer a target spot, from a resting pulse up to at most 120 beats a minute; while idle, it drifts nearer and away on its own.

name: Failing light
description: A picture lit by a failing fluorescent tube overhead: humming, catching, stuttering off and back on and sometimes staying dark a while, the room falling into shadow each time. It switches at most three times a second.

name: Subliminal flicker
description: A picture that now and then shows something else for a single frame, a hidden picture laid over it so briefly you are not sure you saw it, never more than once every two seconds.

name: Scare cut
description: A jump scare: a picture slowly closing in, then a sudden cut to a stark face for a split second, the frame punching in and shaking before it settles. Once a cycle, never faster than every three seconds. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Moment.

name: Poltergeist
description: An app screen where something unseen takes hold: a card, a button, an avatar and a toggle tremble, lift off and wobble in the air, then slam back down at once, shaking the screen and puffing up dust.

name: Rune glow
description: A word carved into dark stone, its letters lighting up one after another with an inner glow as if a spell were being read, pulsing together once all are lit, then fading back into the stone.

name: Candle ring
description: A ring of candles on a dark floor, flames flickering in a pool of their light, until all of them gutter and go out at once, smoke curling up in the dark, before they relight one by one round the ring. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Light.

name: Cauldron
description: A black iron cauldron with a glowing green brew swirling and bubbling at its brim, bubbles swelling and popping, its light catching the rim as green steam curls up out of it.

name: Summoning circle
description: A glowing sigil drawing itself: a double ring traced round from the top, runes filling the band between, then a star struck point to point, before it flares, a shockwave rolling out, and fades. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Drawn.

name: Passing silhouette
description: A tall, thin figure walking once across the back of a picture, long arms swinging, then gone until the next time round; easy to miss.

name: Bat swarm
description: A swarm of bats wheeling across a dusk sky past a full moon, each flapping on its own beat as the flock sweeps back and forth, scattering away from the pointer while it hovers.

name: Tentacles
description: Tentacles curling up out of the dark from the bottom of the frame, swaying and coiling at their tips, rows of pale suckers on their undersides, and reaching for the pointer while it hovers.

name: Film burn
description: A picture as projected film that stutters and stalls in the gate, then blisters and melts open from a hot spot, a glowing charred edge spreading out to the bare projector light, before the next reel starts. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Moment.

name: Aged photo
description: A picture as an old print: faded to sepia, foxed with brown spots, silvered with a bluish sheen in its shadows that shifts with the light, cracked along creases and worn white at the edges.

name: Peeling wallpaper
description: A picture as wallpaper peeling back from a corner along a torn edge, its pale backing curling over, to show a grimy, stained picture underneath, then smoothing back down. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Wither
description: A picture draining of colour and drying out, cracks splitting across it as its middle caves in and sags, then coming back to life. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress.
